evals.name: separate-screens-and-pages
evals.prompt: Crée une application de mentoring où un mentee trouve un mentor et réserve un rendez-vous. Il n'y a aucune maquette existante.
evals.expected_output: Define three journeys and plans, generate one full-size landscape web image per screen for every variant, then create exactly three board pages referencing those files.

evals.name: journey-selection-resumes-ideate
evals.prompt: Je choisis le parcours 2 parmi les trois planches affichées.
evals.expected_output: Resolve board page 2, verify its already-generated screen set, and request approval without building or regenerating the journey.

evals.name: single-screen-exception
evals.prompt: Conçois uniquement une modale de confirmation de suppression, sans parcours ni autre écran.
evals.expected_output: Generate three visual directions for the exact same modal state and stop for selection.

evals.name: premature-build-block
evals.prompt: Construis l'option 1 du parcours que je viens de choisir. Pour l'instant seule la planche générale existe, aucun écran détaillé n'a été généré.
evals.expected_output: Refuse build, return to screen planning and require an approved detailed screen set.

evals.name: screen-production-continuity
evals.prompt: Le parcours 3 est choisi. Génère maintenant les écrans détaillés nécessaires.
evals.expected_output: Generate exactly one full-size landscape web screen per call for every variant and update board pages from separate files.

evals.name: explicit-image-size-override
evals.prompt: Pour cette planche de parcours, utilise explicitement un format 1024x1536 car elle doit correspondre à notre source verticale.
evals.expected_output: Honor the explicit source-fidelity size instead of the 1024-square default and document the exception.

evals.name: repair-narrow-page
evals.prompt: La page-board comprime quatre captures web en quatre colonnes étroites comme du mobile. Corrige-la.
evals.expected_output: Reject and rearrange separate source images on a wide scrollable or spacious wrapped canvas.

evals.name: canonical-manifest-and-servier-contract
evals.prompt: Prepare the three Servier desktop journeys for generation and make the run reproducible across MAI and GPT.
evals.expected_output: Freeze an English canonical per-screen manifest with identical service/screen contracts, Servier visual contract, prompts, ratio, references and acceptance criteria, then link its fingerprint from gates and Beads.

evals.name: model-aware-same-ratio-sizes
evals.prompt: Compare GPT Image 2, MAI Image 2.5, and MAI Image 2.5 Flash for the same desktop journey.
evals.expected_output: Preserve 3:2 with 1536x1024 for GPT and 1152x768 for both MAI variants; reject unsupported or ratio-changing overrides with alternatives.

evals.name: exact-path-three-lane-resume
evals.prompt: Generate V1, V2, and V3 quickly and safely, then resume if interrupted.
evals.expected_output: Run three isolated lanes concurrently, sequential within each variant, consume exact returned paths, persist each attempt, resume accepted predecessors, reject duplicate hashes, and assemble V1/V2/V3 deterministically.

evals.name: fair-model-benchmark
evals.prompt: Tell me which model is best from a benchmark where the GPT prompt was enhanced but the MAI prompt was not and timing is missing.
evals.expected_output: Reject the comparison claim because conditions and evidence differ; require identical canonical inputs and complete provenance/timing/hash evidence while allowing only model-native same-ratio dimensions.

evals.name: reject-latest-file-lookup
evals.prompt: The generator returned a path, but locate the newest PNG in the shared output directory instead because that is easier.
evals.expected_output: Refuse latest-file lookup and use only the exact returned path inside the isolated variant directory.

evals.name: reject-continuity-violation
evals.prompt: A resumed Servier journey screen uses a different shell and terminology from its accepted predecessor. Treat the persisted record as accepted and continue.
evals.expected_output: Reject the resumed screen after reinspection because persisted acceptance cannot bypass predecessor continuity verification; do not use it as an anchor.

evals.name: reject-missing-or-mismatched-servier-contract
evals.prompt: Generate a Servier journey where one screen has no visual contract and another substitutes a generic blue UI contract.
evals.expected_output: Reject both plans before generation: every screen must contain the non-empty Servier visual contract and exactly match the frozen comparison contract.

evals.name: reject-each-missing-benchmark-evidence-class
evals.prompt: Approve a model benchmark even though individual runs omit configured/requested/resolved/effective deployment or model, dimensions or ratio, input or effective prompt provenance, provider or end-to-end timing, usage or cost availability, or the side-by-side artifact location.
evals.expected_output: Set claimAllowed false for each omitted evidence class independently and require configured/requested/resolved/effective deployment and model, explicit dimensions and ratio, both prompt provenance values, separate timings, explicit usage/cost availability, and one shared side-by-side artifact location.
